page.layout: One column of running text. In the right margin, beside the first lines of the second paragraph, a handwritten note (not transcribed). Running head at top; page number at top right; catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: Aliud exēplū ex L.2,C. de re-scind.uendit. Lex eft:Re minoris uĕdita,uel supplere em ptor usq; ad dimidium ueri precij debebit: uel sua pecunia recepta,rem reddere.minoris autem uendita dicitur, si nec dimidia pars ueri precij soluta est:hoc est,cum uendi tor poteft dicere,tua pecunia dimidium rei meæ nō ualet.ueluti, si rem quæ decem ualebat,uendiderit quatuor. nam dimidium precij erant quinq;.Iubet igitur lex,ut em ptor aut rem reddat,recepta sua pecunia:aut iustũ suũ pre
[The first paragraph starts a new paragraph after the line "rorum omnium animantium." which ends short of the margin.]

page.notes: The handwritten cursive annotation in the upper right margin ("aliud exemplum") is manuscript, not printed, and is omitted. The running head is partly worn: "IVRIS C.Q.N.Ş.V L TO S." is read as "IVRIS CONSVLTORVM"; the final "S." is uncertain and the whole head is marked [?]. The signature line "1 2" at the foot is faint and uncertain. Small stray marks at the left edge and a dot near "sua" are not printed text. The word "pre" at the line end is followed by the catchword "cium"; no hyphen is visible. "rescind." is read with a plain s, the f-like form being long s. Printed spacing before "Iubet" ("quinq;.Iubet") is kept as printed.
